Actions: inspect frontend service/pod config/env for proxied image fetching URL and timeout values AND inspect frontend-proxy listener config (/listeners or admin) and k8s Service for its exposed port.

Image-provider pod runtime check: Determine whether image-provider pod (image-provider-79dbdd7cf4-gnmjv) is performing blocking outbound calls that consistently take ~10s. Hypothesis: resource exhaustion (CPU throttling, low replica count or thread-pool exhaustion) is causing requests to queue and produce long latencies. Actions: check pod resource requests/limits, kubectl top (if available) for CPU/memory, pod spec for replica count, and application logs for indications of exhausted thread pools or backpressure.
